description: A terminal screen that confirms a completed flow and presents its next steps.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Success Screen is a terminal view for confirming a completed flow and presenting its next steps. For example, a payment screen can confirm a supplier payment, show its details, and offer a clear exit.
whenToUseItems: A flow has completed and its result needs a dedicated confirmation.
The confirmation and its relevant details or next steps belong together.
whenNotToUseItems: To filter or select items, use [Chips](docs:components-chips--docs).
To trigger an action without a terminal confirmation, use a Button.
variantRows: Neutral|Confirms a result that is still in progress.
Negative|Confirms that a flow did not succeed.

formatting.title: Formatting
formatting.layoutText: The layout responds to the component container: desktop actions appear at 530px and above; below that width, the screen fills its container and actions are hidden.
layoutRows: Mobile|Full width|Actions are hidden; the top bar is optional.

rows: 1|Status icon|No|Shown when a Tag label is provided.
2|Status label|No|Identifies the result in the Tag.
3|Title|Yes|States the result of the completed flow.
7|Actions|No|Up to two actions; hidden below the desktop container width.

content.title: Content
content.text: Use concise, specific copy and include only details that help explain the completed result.
writingItems: Use one clear title that states the result.
Use the description for brief supporting context.
Keep each content row focused on a distinct detail.
content.shortTitleDo: Use a short title that confirms the result.
content.shortTitleDont: Avoid a full sentence in the title; put supporting detail in the description.
content.detailsDo: Show distinct payment details in the content rows.
content.detailsDont: Do not repeat the same completion message in every row.

behaviors.title: Behaviors
behaviors.text: The component uses a container query rather than the viewport width. On mobile, actions are hidden and `showTopBar` can add a close control.
rows: Positive|Positive status color|Positive translucent Tag|Visible at 530px and above
Neutral|Light interface surface|Neutral-02 Tag with calendar icon|Visible at 530px and above
Negative|Dark interface surface|Neutral Tag with X icon|Visible at 530px and above

badge.title: Badge
badge.text: Use Badge to communicate a count or compact status outside a terminal screen.

chips.title: Chips
chips.text: Use Chips for filtering and selection interactions.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
rows: Close control|When shown, the IconButton calls `onClose`; Enter or Space activates it.
Actions|Native buttons support their standard keyboard behavior.
Content|Reading order follows the visual order.

development.title: Development considerations
items: **Use a clear title.** Make the completed result understandable at a glance.
**Do not rely on color alone.** Keep the outcome clear in text.
**Preserve reading order.** Ensure custom content follows a meaningful sequence.
